auth_details: Public open-data endpoints require no API key or signup; call HTTPS endpoints directly. Confirm per-service docs if any restricted routes exist.
free_tier_limits: Free open data; no paid plans published
rate_limits: not published (rate limiting mentioned generically; no public numeric limits)
description: A family of free open-data APIs from the UK Parliament for Members, interests, Commons votes, committees, bills, statutory instruments, and related parliamentary information. The official developer hub at developer.parliament.uk lists the supported public endpoints; many modern services use subdomain APIs (e.g. members-api, bills-api) with OpenAPI specs and no authentication for public read access.
